---
name: scientific-review
description: Review evidence, uncertainty, licensing and verification claims.
---

Audit model manifests, real-label splits, units, geometry assumptions and privacy. Ensure line calls remain uncertain without measured error, airborne speed stays null, camera motion invalidates calibration, and source rights are explicit. Run uv run pytest -q -m "not model", inspect docs/evaluation-provisional.json and docs/verification.md, and identify unexecuted tests. Never write fictional reports.
